mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_task (id, conversation_id, python_run_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{pythonRunId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.conversation_id, t.python_run_id, r.prompt, r.status, r.result, r.error, t.created_at AS task_created_at, r.started_at, r.finished_at FROM agent_task t JOIN agent_run r ON r.run_id = t.python_run_id WHERE t.id = #{taskId}

SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.conversation_id, t.python_run_id, r.prompt, r.status, r.result, r.error, t.created_at AS task_created_at, r.started_at, r.finished_at FROM agent_task t JOIN agent_run r ON r.run_id = t.python_run_id WHERE t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_task t JOIN agent_run r ON r.run_id = t.python_run_id WHERE t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND r.status IN ('CREATED', 'RUNNING')
